checks.name: impulse_response
checks.method: impulse excitation; delay = parabolic-interpolated cross-correlation peak; support at -120 dB of peak

checks.name: swept_response
checks.method: log-chirp deconvolution H=Y/X, magnitude only (delay-invariant); one-sided grid
checks.detail: finite resolution: |H| sampled every 2.930 Hz; behaviour between grid points is NOT certified by this measurement (see fir_certificate)

checks.name: multitone_passband
checks.method: bin-aligned multitone; steady-state segment analysed by quadrature projection (window-free, coherent-gain exact); segment=2048 samples, resolution=23.438 Hz
checks.detail: first 2048 samples discarded as transient; amplitude ratios are delay-invariant

checks.name: stopband_leakage
checks.method: bin-aligned multitone; steady-state segment analysed by quadrature projection (window-free, coherent-gain exact); segment=2048 samples, resolution=23.438 Hz
checks.detail: first 2048 samples discarded as transient; amplitude ratios are delay-invariant

checks.name: nyquist_edge
checks.method: tones placed below fs/2 with 100.0 Hz guard; quadrature projection at the true frequency (no negative-frequency aliasing)

checks.name: chunk_invariance
checks.method: 12 random partitions (2-8 chunks, seed=1234) vs single-chunk reference

checks.name: shift_invariance
checks.method: ascending shift search (first failure is minimal)
